optional_index_fields.policy: Absence is reported, not a core failure. Any returned inconsistent reference fails. Actual Agent eval attributes, row identity, direct scores and prediction parentage remain required.

limitations: Delivery and exact score matching do not establish answer or judge correctness.

Original status and grades remain unchanged. Any separately published supplemental judge score is excluded. A budget denial before provider dispatch has no LLM response/span and is not counted as a provider call.

Usage reconciles known returned estimates, not invoices; scorer cost is in the exact matched score receipt, not Agent span totals. Rejected provider requests without returned usage remain unpriced, separate from pre-dispatch budget denials.

Original successful-call checks are retained, including their expected failures for a rejected invocation. Separate delivery checks require exact successful responses and a matching completed error span; they do not turn the failed request into a success.
Snapshot only; absent records remain unverified, not automatically permanent losses.
No Signal feedback queried; the separate Signal receipt checks existing configuration only.
